external_deps: Provider API key (Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Azure, X.AI, DIAL) or Ollama

review.tagline: MCP server that lets Claude Code, Codex CLI and Cursor call multiple LLMs
review.summary: PAL is a Python MCP server that exposes tools such as chat, thinkdeep, planner, consensus, codereview, precommit and debug to a host CLI or IDE, and routes each call to a chosen model from Gemini, OpenAI, Azure, X.AI, OpenRouter, DIAL or Ollama. It keeps conversation threads across tools and models, and its clink tool launches other CLIs (Gemini CLI, Codex, Claude Code) as subagents with role prompts.
review.audience: Developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor who want multi-model input
strengths: Works with many hosts: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Qwen CLI, Cursor
Supports Gemini, OpenAI, Azure, X.AI, OpenRouter, DIAL and local Ollama models
Conversation threading carries context across models and after host context resets
clink spawns other CLIs as isolated subagents with roles like planner and codereviewer
weaknesses: Needs at least one provider API key or a local Ollama setup
Each enabled tool adds to the context window; six tools are disabled by default
License is reported as NOASSERTION, so terms need manual checking
Last commit was 2025-12-15, so recent model releases may lack support
needs: Needs Python 3.10+, Git, uv, Provider API key (Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Azure, X.AI, DIAL) or Ollama
Models: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Grok, Azure OpenAI
